How it moves

  • Ready: slow turn, dim, a quiet breath.
  • Listening: the shell wakes; the arc at the top is the mic level.
  • Hearing you: brighter, the shell ripples with your voice.
  • Thinking: the sphere draws in, the core strands spin fast, two arcs chase round.
  • Speaking: the core swells with ghost's voice, a ring of bars and sparks off the shell.
  • Muted: dims and slows, no level.
  • Pixel style: the orb drawn small and blown up in square cells, shaded with a 4x4 ordered dither in five colours, stepped like a sprite. The ghost inside keeps its own faces: talking, thinking, waiting, sleepy when muted.
  • Maya: her mood's frame, with a talking mouth (s, eh, oh, oo, braces added) pasted over it by her voice's level; eyes shut for a blink and when muted (greyed), a bob in sprite steps, three dots while thinking. Every frame is lined up and colour-matched to the neutral one on load.
  • Hologram: her backdrop cut away, her brightness put on the skin's five colours (dark parts see-through), scanlines, a bright line sweeping down, rows that slip now and then, a flicker; added as light on Graphite.
